title: 빈칸
sp: K-Pop and Future Bass fusion. The arrangement centers on a fingerpicked acoustic guitar with a warm, natural tone. slap bass, clean funk guitar, punchy drums. Female vocals are processed with light compression and a subtle chorus effect, delivered in a rhythmic, conversational style in the verses and a melodic, airy tone in the pre-chorus. Atmospheric vinyl crackle and ambient city street noise are layered throughout the arrangement. Acoustic rhythm guitar plays percussive la pompe style chords in 4/4 time.
